group.name: SSC (Staff Selection Commission)
group.intro: Fees and fee exemptions vary by exam, so check each notice. In recent notices most SSC exams charge ₹100, with women, SC, ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen exempt. Apply only on ssc.gov.in after One-Time Registration (OTR). Aadhaar authentication is optional for CGL 2026, and other identity documents are accepted. Aadhaar checks do apply to the scribe rules.

rows.rule: CAPF and Railway: up to 5 years for the first batch, 3 years after

notes: Final-year students can usually apply for graduate exams if they will have the degree by the cut-off date in the notice.
EWS gets reservation but no age relaxation in central exams.
OBC relaxation applies only to the Non-Creamy Layer, with a valid central-format certificate.
Widows and divorced women (not remarried), Group C posts: up to 35 (UR), 38 (OBC), 40 (SC/ST).
Central government civilian employees with 3 years' service: up to 40 (UR), 43 (OBC), 45 (SC/ST) for some posts.
Cut-off date: CGL uses 1 August of the exam year; check each notice for the others.

exams.name: SSC CGL (Combined Graduate Level)
exams.overview: The biggest graduate-level central exam, for Group B and Group C posts at Pay Level 4 to 8.
exams.frequency: Once a year (typical: notification around April–June)

posts.name: Assistant Audit Officer (Central and State Cadre)
posts.department: C&AG — Indian Audit & Accounts Department (Group B Gazetted)

posts.name: Assistant Section Officer
posts.department: Central Secretariat, MEA, Railways, IB, AFHQ

posts.name: Inspector (Central Excise, GST, Preventive Officer, Examiner)

eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years. Cut-off date: 1 August of the exam year.
eligibility.extraRequirement: JSO: 12th with Maths (60%) or graduation with Statistics; Statistical Investigator: graduation with Statistics; final-year students can apply if they have the degree by the cut-off date

ageLimits.post: 18–27 posts (Auditor, Accountant, Tax Assistant, UDC etc.)

ageLimits.note: Lower age is 20 for some of these posts.

selectionSteps: Tier 1 — qualifying screening (marks not counted in final merit)
Tier 2 — merit exam (Paper I for all; Paper II for JSO; Paper III for AAO and Assistant Accounts Officer)
Skill tests inside Tier 2 — Computer Knowledge module and Data Entry Speed Test (DEST)
Physical / medical test for CBI SI, Inspector (CBIC, Narcotics) posts
Document verification and post allotment by merit and preference

stages.name: Tier 1
stages.note: The 2026 notice introduced sectional timing in Tier 1.

stages.name: Tier 2 Paper I

rows.subject: Session II: Data Entry Speed Test (qualifying), 2,000 key depressions

stages.note: Negative marking in Tier 2 differs by paper and section, so check the 2026 notice for the exact values.

stages.name: Tier 2 Paper II (Statistics)
stages.note: Only for candidates shortlisted for JSO / Statistical Investigator.

stages.name: Tier 2 Paper III (General Studies – Finance & Economics)
stages.note: New in 2026. Only for candidates shortlisted for Assistant Audit Officer / Assistant Accounts Officer. For AAO posts, merit is based on Paper I plus Paper III.

syllabus.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
syllabus.topics: Number system, percentage, ratio, average, interest, profit & loss, time & work, speed & distance, mensuration, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, data interpretation, statistics

syllabus.subject: Reasoning
syllabus.topics: Analogy, classification, series, coding-decoding, blood relations, direction, syllogism, Venn diagram, matrix, paper folding, embedded figures, puzzles

syllabus.subject: English
syllabus.topics: Vocabulary, synonyms & antonyms, idioms, one-word substitution, spelling, error spotting, sentence improvement, active/passive, narration, cloze test, reading comprehension

syllabus.subject: General Awareness
syllabus.topics: History, geography, polity, economy, general science, static GK, current affairs, sports, awards, books

syllabus.subject: Computer
syllabus.topics: Computer basics, MS Office, internet, email, networking, cyber security

syllabus.subject: Statistics (JSO)
syllabus.topics: Collection & presentation of data, central tendency, dispersion, correlation & regression, probability, sampling, index numbers, time series

syllabus.subject: Paper III (AAO / Assistant Accounts Officer)
syllabus.topics: Finance (financial accounting, auditing basics, Finance Commission, budgeting) and Economics (micro and macro economics, growth and development, money and banking, Indian economy)

rows.men: 157.5 cm; walk 1,600 m in 15 min, cycle 8 km in 30 min
rows.women: 152 cm; walk 1 km in 20 min, cycle 3 km in 25 min

physical.note: Physical standards apply only to some posts.

salary.note: Level 4 (₹25,500 basic) to Level 8 (₹47,600 basic, AAO / Assistant Accounts Officer); estimated gross with 60% DA, HRA and transport allowance. Perks: pension (NPS/UPS), medical (CGHS), LTC, government quarters, children education allowance.

career.profile: ASO handles files and policy notes in ministries; Inspectors do tax assessment, raids and customs duty; Auditors check government accounts.
career.promotion: Typical growth: ASO → Section Officer → Under Secretary; Inspector → Superintendent → Assistant Commissioner.

tips: Maths and English carry a large share of Tier 2 Paper I marks; AAO aspirants must also prepare Finance & Economics for Paper III; practise advanced maths (geometry, trigonometry, algebra) early.
Read one newspaper daily and revise static GK monthly.
Take full-length mocks with sectional timing; practise typing for DEST (about 30 wpm).

currentCycle.note: AAO and Assistant Accounts Officer posts returned in CGL 2026 with a Central and State Cadre structure at Level 8. The final post list and vacancies are in the official notice on ssc.gov.in.

exams.name: SSC CHSL (Combined Higher Secondary Level)
exams.overview: The main 12th-pass central clerk exam, for LDC, Postal Assistant and Data Entry Operator jobs at Level 2 to 4.

posts.name: Lower Division Clerk / Junior Secretariat Assistant

eligibility.extraRequirement: DEO in C&AG: 12th Science with Maths
eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.

selectionSteps: Tier 2 — merit CBT with computer module

rows.subject: LDC / JSA / PA / SA: typing 35 wpm English or 30 wpm Hindi on computer

syllabus.subject: Maths
syllabus.topics: Number system, percentage, ratio, average, interest, profit & loss, time & work, time & distance, mensuration, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, DI

syllabus.subject: Reasoning
syllabus.topics: Analogy, series, coding-decoding, puzzle, blood relation, direction, Venn diagram, mirror & water image, paper cutting

syllabus.subject: English
syllabus.topics: Spotting errors, fill in the blanks, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, one-word substitution, active/passive, narration, cloze, comprehension

syllabus.subject: General Awareness
syllabus.topics: History, geography, polity, economy, science, current affairs, static GK

syllabus.subject: Computer
syllabus.topics: Basics, Windows, MS Office, internet, email, security

salary.note: Gross about ₹35,000 (LDC) to ₹54,000 (PA/DEO) a month, plus pension, CGHS, LTC. Basic: Level 2 ₹19,900; Level 4 ₹25,500; Level 5 ₹29,200.

career.profile: LDC handles office records, typing and file movement; PA handles post office counters and accounts.
career.promotion: LDC → UDC → Assistant → Section Officer through departmental exams.

tips: Same core syllabus as CGL at an easier level; CHSL and CGL can be prepared together.
Start typing practice 3 months before the skill test.
English in Tier 2 rewards vocabulary and grammar rules.

exams.name: SSC MTS (Multi-Tasking Staff) & Havaldar (CBIC, CBN)
exams.overview: The largest 10th-pass central office exam, at Pay Level 1 with no interview and no skill test.

posts.name: MTS (peon, daftary, jamadar, junior gestetner operator, chowkidar, safaiwala, mali)

eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.

stages.name: CBT Session I
stages.note: No negative marking. Session I is qualifying-plus-merit. The full CBT is 90 minutes and 270 marks.

stages.name: CBT Session II
stages.note: Session II is evaluated only if the candidate clears Session I.

syllabus.subject: Maths
syllabus.topics: Number system, HCF/LCM, decimals & fractions, percentage, ratio, average, interest, profit & loss, time & work, speed, mensuration (basic), DI (simple charts)

syllabus.subject: Reasoning
syllabus.topics: Alphanumeric series, analogy, coding-decoding, odd one out, direction, Venn diagram, blood relation, puzzle, mirror image

syllabus.subject: GA
syllabus.topics: History, geography, polity, economy, science, culture, sports, current affairs

syllabus.subject: English
syllabus.topics: Vocabulary, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, comprehension

physical.note: Havaldar only. MTS posts have no physical test.

career.profile: Office support, file movement, record keeping; Havaldars assist customs officers.
career.promotion: MTS can become LDC through a departmental exam.

tips: Session I has no negative marking, so attempt every question.
Focus on basic Maths and NCERT-level GK.

exams.name: SSC GD Constable
exams.overview: Recruits constables for all central armed police forces, with tens of thousands of posts each year at Level 3.

posts.name: Constable (GD)
posts.department: BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB, SSF

eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years. Ex-Agniveers: as per the notice.
eligibility.extraRequirement: Physical standards; an NCC certificate gives bonus marks

selectionSteps: CBT (bonus marks for NCC 'A', 'B', 'C' certificate holders: 2%, 3%, 5%)
Detailed Medical Exam and document verification
Merit list force-wise and state-wise (vacancies are allotted by state/district domicile)

syllabus.subject: Reasoning
syllabus.topics: Analogy, similarities, spatial visualisation, coding-decoding, number series, figure series, Venn diagram, arithmetic reasoning

syllabus.subject: GK
syllabus.topics: India and neighbours, history, culture, geography, economy, polity, sports, science, current affairs

syllabus.subject: Maths
syllabus.topics: Number system, percentage, ratio, average, interest, profit & loss, discount, mensuration, time & distance, time & work

syllabus.subject: English / Hindi
syllabus.topics: Basic grammar, vocabulary, comprehension

physical.note: Height relaxations also apply for hill areas, North-East states, Garhwalis, Kumaonis, Gorkhas and others.

exams.medical: Vision 6/6 and 6/9 without glasses; no knock-knee, flat foot, varicose veins or squint; tattoos only in allowed places.

salary.note: Plus ration money, risk allowance and free accommodation at postings.

career.profile: Border guarding (BSF, ITBP, SSB), internal security (CRPF), airport and industrial security (CISF).

tips: The physical test is a major elimination stage; start the 5 km running routine at least 4 months before.
The written cut-off is high in popular states, so practise speed with 15–20 mocks.
Get an NCC certificate if possible for bonus marks.

exams.name: SSC CPO (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police & CAPFs)
exams.overview: The graduate entry to Sub-Inspector rank in Delhi Police and the five CAPFs, at Level 6.

eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.
eligibility.extraRequirement: Men applying for Delhi Police: valid LMV (car) licence by the PET date

ageLimits.note: No ex-servicemen relaxation in this row.

selectionSteps: Detailed Medical Exam and document verification

career.profile: Investigating officer in Delhi Police; platoon commander in CAPFs.

tips: Paper 2 is 200 English questions, so English carries heavy weight in final merit.
Train for the 100 m sprint and long jump, not only endurance.

exams.name: SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive)
exams.overview: The 12th-pass SSC exam for Constable (Executive) in Delhi Police, at Level 3.

eligibility.qualification: 12th pass (11th pass allowed for wards of Delhi Police personnel)
eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.
eligibility.extraRequirement: Men: valid LMV licence by the PET date

physical.note: Standards shown for men up to 30 years and women up to 25 years.

tips: GK carries half the marks — focus on current affairs and Delhi-specific GK.

exams.name: SSC Delhi Police Head Constable (Ministerial and AWO/TPO)
exams.overview: SSC exam for Delhi Police Head Constable posts in office work (Ministerial) and wireless (AWO/TPO), at Level 4.

posts.name: HC (AWO / TPO): Assistant Wireless Operator / Tele-Printer Operator
posts.qualification: 12th with Science & Maths, or relevant ITI

eligibility.qualification: 12th pass (AWO/TPO: 12th with Science & Maths, or ITI)
eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.

qualificationByPost.qualification: 12th with Science & Maths, or ITI (mechanic-cum-operator electronic communication)

physical.note: Same standards for HC (Ministerial) and HC (AWO / TPO).

salary.note: Level 4 for both HC (Ministerial) and HC (AWO / TPO).

exams.name: SSC Stenographer Grade C & D
exams.overview: The 12th-pass SSC exam for Stenographer Grade C (Level 6) and Grade D (Level 4) posts.

eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.

rows.subject: Grade C: dictation 100 wpm for 10 min; transcription 40 min (English) / 55 min (Hindi)
Grade D: dictation 80 wpm for 10 min; transcription 50 min (English) / 65 min (Hindi)

salary.note: Grade C: Level 6, approx. gross ₹63,000 – 73,000 a month. Grade D: Level 4, approx. gross ₹46,000 – 54,000 a month.

tips: Shorthand needs 6–12 months of daily practice.

exams.overview: Recruits Civil, Mechanical and Electrical Junior Engineers for central departments at Level 6.

posts.name: Junior Engineer (Civil)

posts.name: Junior Engineer (Mechanical)
posts.department: CPWD, MES, BRO, CWC, Farakka Barrage and others

eligibility.extraRequirement: Some departments (MES, BRO): diploma + 2 years' experience, or degree

exams.overview: Phase-wise SSC recruitment for many separate posts at 10th, 12th and graduate level.

eligibility.ageNote: Ex-servicemen: age minus military service + 3 years.
